requirements.name: Developer-provided data specifications, process descriptions and help
requirements.priority_reason: Staff need documentation and meaningful error feedback to author and troubleshoot reports; developer-provided specs, process descriptions and help were repeatedly required.
requirements.append_explanation: The online HTML help system shall be usable with common assistive technologies (for example: screen readers and screen-magnification software) and the developer documentation for the help system shall list which assistive technologies were used during testing and describe how accessibility is supported. The help-system documentation shall describe where accessibility-related controls, semantics or landmarks (for example ARIA roles/landmarks, labels or other assistive hooks) are exposed in the help UI so administrators and accessibility testers can locate and verify accessibility features.
